plugins.name: build-fleet
plugins.description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house. A product tier (PLAN → PLAN_REVIEW → PLAN_FINALIZE → DEVELOPING, human-ratified) above a per-feature SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF machine. Features inherit a binding stack-of-record + per-feature intent; hook-enforced gates, dynamic-workflow adversarial review + plan interrogation, tests-first fan-out builds, three-tier routing, a backlog DEVELOPING loop, and headless orchestrator support. v0.5 adds a parallel troubleshoot-fix bug lane (REPORT → REPRODUCE → DIAGNOSE → FIX → VERIFY → HANDOFF) — diagnosis.md is the contract, with an inviolable reproducing-test gate, an inverted-review.js confirmation workflow, and a sev0 hotfix fast-path.
